why: Commit 3 is 'keep the way that measured better': it measures whether revalidateTag with { expire: 0 } still redraws, then chooses way B (change how publishing expires the storefront cache) or way A (client word modules with scan-test exceptions), and must judge per screen whether it relies on the redraw. make_it_cheaper: Measure way B once before handing the step over and write the outcome into the brief (and which screens rely on the redraw), so commit 3 becomes one specified path.
brief_problems: Commit 2 asks the executor to find the words and menu inside an RSC payload by 'area names such as builder, blocks, common, shell' without a parser or a known shape
